Berrien County seeks temporary deputy register for trial court at $18.75 per hour
Berrien County is hiring a temporary, part-time Deputy Register for its Trial Court at $18.75 per hour. The position involves clerical and administrative duties supporting Family Division cases. Applicants must meet education and typing requirements and pass pre-employment screenings.
Berrien County is seeking applicants for a temporary, part-time Deputy Register position in the Trial Court, with a published hourly wage of $18.75. The job posting was announced October 6 and outlines a range of clerical and administrative duties supporting Family Division cases.
The Deputy Register will be responsible for maintaining accurate case records and information systems, processing and filing legal documents for juvenile, child protective, probate, and mental commitment proceedings, and ensuring compliance with procedural requirements. Additional duties include providing procedural and case-related information to attorneys, agencies, parties, and the public, as well as managing filing and statutory fees. The position also involves opening and maintaining case files, assigning case numbers, preparing and distributing court documents, attending court hearings, and assisting with maintaining official records of proceedings.
According to the job description, the Deputy Register will schedule hearings, conferences, and pretrial or status proceedings, review files to determine appropriate proceedings, notify parties, coordinate service, and arrange required appearances and appointments. The role also includes processing mental commitment cases, reviewing fiduciary accounts and inventories, and monitoring compliance of contracted providers. The job description states, "This description is intended to illustrate the type and level of work being performed by persons assigned to this job. It may not be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities required by a person so classified."
Applicants must have an associate degree and/or paralegal certification, or a high school diploma or equivalent with two years of legal or governmental office experience. Special requirements include the possibility of obtaining and maintaining SCAO Certified Electronic Operator certification, passing a pre-employment physical, drug test, and background check, and being subject to fingerprinting and random drug and alcohol testing during employment. The position requires the ability to lift up to 25 pounds, reach and bend, and sit or stand for prolonged periods. The Deputy Register may be assigned to work at any Berrien County Trial Court location.
Required knowledge and skills include familiarity with Michigan statutes, codes, and court rules, the ability to analyze legal documents, maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and communicate effectively. The position also requires a typing speed of 40 words per minute net. Applicants who have not previously taken a typing test with Berrien County are instructed to contact the Personnel Department to schedule one.
Applications can be submitted online, by email, fax, mail, or in person to the Berrien County Administration Building, Personnel Department, 701 Main St., St. Joseph, MI 49085. A Berrien County job application is required for consideration.
